description: Illustrative shapes for WO-021's MFA data — the actual TOTP secret and backup codes used in tests are generated fresh per test run (real crypto against real, freshly-created RSA/AES key material from InMemoryKmsService), not replayed from a static fixture, since a real TOTP secret's validity is time-dependent and a static committed code would be permanently expired. This file documents the shapes those real values take.

classificationTierBehavior.elevationDuration: session-lifetime (no separate expiry beyond the session itself)
restrictedElevationMinutes (default 60), re-verification required after that even mid-session
